en: Colorized historical postcard view of a curved street lined with red‑tiled houses, trees, and an iron railing in the foreground. On the left is part of a large Gothic-style building and in the distance two tall church spires rise above the rooftops. The scene is calm with a few small figures walking. Printed German text at the top identifies the place and viewpoint, and there is a red handwritten date or number near the top.
